request.description: Create a new user account. Either email or phone is required.
Authenticate the scanner device for an event using the signed-in operator JWT and the scanner token returned at registration.
Verify one signed QR credential against the selected product access and atomically record the online admission attempt. Retries with the same client_scan_id return the stored attempt.

Upload at most 500 offline scans. Retry the same client_upload_id after an interrupted request to receive the stored snapshot; each client_scan_id is independently idempotent. Send an empty scans array for a heartbeat and synchronization delta. The reported result is advisory and the server reconciles the credential, revocations, zones, and admission uses authoritatively.

Recover an active credential by checksummed PNR, canonical Ethiopian phone, or authorized online help-desk search. Every manual admission requires a controlled reason code, returns minimal disambiguation, and sends the selected credential through the same admission validator as QR. For phone use method=phone; for online help-desk search use method=online and omit admission fields until a result is selected.

Online manager correction for an immutable identity-mismatch attempt. The server revalidates the current credential, schedule, zones, revocations, and usage limit, then appends one linked successful check-in when eligible. Offline scan uploads cannot use this endpoint.

Append-only manager reversal for every admission use created by a successful check-in. The operation creates one complete reversal group, never edits historical check-in or use rows, and publishes the reversal version for scanner synchronization.
List organization scanner devices for an organization owner/admin or platform administrator. The response excludes token digests and idempotency data.

Rotate a scanner credential as an authorized organization administrator. Requires Idempotency-Key. The plaintext token is returned once; an exact replay does not rotate again or recover plaintext, so use a new key for a new rotation.
Revoke a compromised or lost scanner device and its active event assignments. Requires Idempotency-Key. Offline scanners may continue using their last synchronized state until they reconnect.

List the authenticated user's owned tickets. The wallet includes event/product/date/venue context, purchased non-ticket add-ons, and only the current active credential's static QR and PNR/lookup code; payment, provider, holder, scanner, and old-generation fields are never returned.

item.name: Guest Shadow Checkout
item.description: Phone-confirmed guest checkout. Keep quote and view tokens opaque, use a fresh Idempotency-Key per mutation, and never cache ticket responses.

request.description: Request this for a guest zero-total selection only. For access_code/invitation offers, provide the per-item audience_proof; authorization is checked without consuming the proof.

response.name: Paid selection does not need OTP

request.description: A purpose-bound guest_admission verification token is required before a zero-total ticket is issued. A paid guest selection follows the existing checkout and post-payment claim flow.
Positive-total guests follow the existing phone-bound checkout and post-payment claim flow. No ticket is issued before payment.
Use the order_access_token returned by a positive-total guest admission selection. It is scoped to one order, buyer, and canonical phone.
Refresh a guest admission payment with the same order_access_token returned by selection creation.
One order covers all automatic ticket lines, including a zero-priced line. No ticket is issued until the positive total is paid.

Resume an approved manual registration or accept an offered waitlist registration. The backend revalidates price and capacity, transfers any offer hold, and returns checkout_required or a zero-total fulfillment action.
OTP requests are accepted only when this ticket offer is currently sold out, waitlist_enabled, and its audience proof is valid. The access code is checked but not consumed.
Enrollment rechecks sold-out inventory under lock, consumes/claims audience proof atomically with registration creation, and honors manual approval before queueing.
